Closing Date for Online Registration & Payment of Application Fees

howToApply: Register on the NATS 2.0 Portal (www.nats.education.gov.in) before applying. Only candidates who passed graduation on or after 1st April 2022 need to register here. Ensure 100% complete profile on the portal.
Note down the Enrolment ID generated in NATS 2.0 Portal for future correspondence.
Visit the Bank���s website www.indianbank.bank.in and click on the Careers page or visit https://www.nats.education.gov.in and click on ‘Engagement of Apprentices in Indian Bank – 2026’.
Click on ‘Click here for New Registration’, enter Name, contact details and email ID. Note the Provisional Registration Number and Password generated.
Fill in the application form. Use ‘SAVE AND NEXT’ to save data if unable to complete in one go.

Upload scanned photograph (4.5cm x 3.5cm, 20KB–50KB), signature (black ink on white paper, 10KB–20KB), left thumb impression (20KB–50KB), and handwritten declaration (50KB–100KB) as per specifications in Annexure-II.
Preview and verify all details before clicking ‘COMPLETE REGISTRATION’.
Proceed to the ‘Payment’ tab and pay the application fee online using Debit/Credit Card or Internet Banking.
On successful payment, an e-Receipt will be generated. Take a printout of the e-Receipt and online application form for future reference.
Do NOT send the printout to the Bank.

dates.event: Last date of payment and submission of Online Application

howToApply: Visit the official website: bceceboard.bihar.gov.in and click on the ���Online Portal of Senior Resident / Tutor under Health Dept.’ link.
Click on ‘Apply for Senior Resident / Tutor’ link, then click the ‘New Registration’ button.

Step-One (Registration): Fill all information correctly in the Online Application Form. Use your own or parent’s email address and mobile number. Verify the mobile number and email address using the verification code sent to them.

Step-Two (Multi-Step Application Form): After registration, Sign In and complete: (a) Department Selection, (b) Personal Information, (c) Contact Details, (d) Educational Information, (e) Upload Photo & Signature. Click ‘Save & Continue’ after each step.

Step-Three (Application Preview & Final Submit): Review all entries. If any anomaly found, click ‘Back to Edit’ and rectify. After verification, click ‘Final Submit & Proceed to Payment’ and pay the Counselling Fee.
Step-Four (Payment of Counselling Fee): Pay Rs. 2250/- through Online mode only (Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI). Processing charges are additional.
Step-Five (Download Confirmation Page & Fee Receipt): After successful payment, download the Confirmation Page & Fee Receipt and re-verify entries. Download the Confirmation Page for future use.
Hard copy of Application Form need not be sent to the Board’s office but must be produced at the time of counselling.

howToApply: Candidates must first mandatorily register themselves on the NATS portal (https://nats.education.gov.in) by navigating to the ‘Student Register/Login’ section.
After registration, candidates will receive an email from BFSI SSC inviting them to fill up a detailed application and make payment for the Online Examination for ‘LIC HFL Apprenticeship Program’.
Visit https://beep.bfsissc.com to submit additional information and make the examination fee payment before 01-Nov-2026.
Note your Enrolment ID issued by the NATS portal for all future correspondence.
All eligible applicants who have paid the examination fee will receive an online examination link and login credentials from BFSI SSC on the day before the examination date.
Appear for the online remote proctored examination on 07-Nov-2026 from home using a camera-enabled device with good internet connectivity.
Shortlisted candidates will be invited for Document Verification & Personal Interview at LIC HFL offices on 15-Nov-2026.
Final selected candidates will receive engagement letters from LIC HFL tentatively in the 3rd week of November.
